lines.text: Miriam and Aaron criticized Moses because of the Cushite woman he had married, and said the LORD also spoke through them.
The LORD told the three to come out to the Tent of Meeting, then came down in a pillar of cloud.
The LORD called Moses and Aaron forward and said He spoke with Moses face to face, clearly and not in riddles.
Miriam became leprous, and Aaron pleaded with Joshua, so Moses cried out to the LORD to heal her.
Miriam was confined outside the camp for seven days, and afterward the people set out from Hazeroth and camped in the Wilderness of Paran.
